references.title: The Oracle Problem in Software Testing: A Survey
fresh_scope: Testing oracles judge behavior using available observations and an oracle relation.
fresh_limitations: The selected oracle definitions do not turn a passed finite suite into an all-input equivalence proof.

positions.paragraph:
\subsection{Behavioral evidence is relative to an oracle and a domain}
A test result establishes a property only for the exercised inputs, observer, and oracle. The oracle problem therefore prevents an execution trace from being interpreted in isolation~\cite{weyuker1982,barr2015}. Differential testing obtains an oracle by comparing implementations and has exposed defects in compilers and other complex systems~\cite{mckeeman1998,yang2011compiler}; metamorphic testing instead checks relations among executions when individual expected outputs are unavailable~\cite{chen2018metamorphic,segura2016metamorphic}. Translation validation checks each transformed program against its source rather than proving the transformer correct once and for all~\cite{pnueli1998,necula2000,tristan2011}, while equivalence modulo inputs makes the exercised domain explicit~\cite{le2014emi}. Verified compilation and proof-producing optimization occupy the stronger end of this spectrum, where transformations carry formal semantic justification~\cite{leroy2009,lopes2015}.

The selected oracle definitions do not turn a passed finite suite into an all-input equivalence proof. references.title: A Taxonomy of Obfuscating Transformations

positions.paragraph:
\subsection{Watermark evaluation assumes a usable program}
Software watermarking predates neural code generation. Early schemes embedded identifiers in control flow, object structure, program state, or source-level transformations and evaluated stealth, robustness, and resistance to semantics-preserving attacks~\cite{collberg1997,venkatesan2001,stern2000,monden2000,collberg2002,nagra2004}. Two lessons from that literature remain central. First, the detector may be syntactic or statistical, but the transformation is still constrained by the program behavior that the artifact is supposed to preserve. Second, robustness is always relative to a transformation class, observer, and attacker model; it is not an intrinsic property of a detector score.

references.title: A Systematic Review on Regression Test Selection Techniques

positions.paragraph:
\subsection{Reuse and early stopping require a comparison-specific invariant}
Regression-test selection avoids repeated execution by identifying tests affected by a program change. Safe techniques preserve a specified fault-detection capability under explicit assumptions, while empirical studies characterize granularity, precision, and cost~\cite{rothermel1997,rothermel1998,engstrom2010,yoo2012}. Test-case prioritization changes the execution order so that relevant failures appear earlier~\cite{rothermel2001}. Test selection for learned systems likewise chooses cases using downstream objectives and available metadata~\cite{ma2021selection}. These lines motivate avoiding redundant suites, but ordinary change-based reuse does not answer our identity question: the same candidate can have different behavioral labels under different references or harnesses, and different version rows can assert the same proposition even when their production paths differ.

positions.paragraph:
\subsection{Behavioral evidence is relative to an oracle and a domain}
A test result establishes a property only for the exercised inputs, observer, and oracle. The oracle problem therefore prevents an execution trace from being interpreted in isolation~\cite{weyuker1982,barr2015}. Differential testing obtains an oracle by comparing implementations and has exposed defects in compilers and other complex systems~\cite{mckeeman1998,yang2011compiler}; metamorphic testing instead checks relations among executions when individual expected outputs are unavailable~\cite{chen2018metamorphic,segura2016metamorphic}. Translation validation checks each transformed program against its source rather than proving the transformer correct once and for all~\cite{pnueli1998,necula2000,tristan2011}, while equivalence modulo inputs makes the exercised domain explicit~\cite{le2014emi}. Verified compilation and proof-producing optimization occupy the stronger end of this spectrum, where transformations carry formal semantic justification~\cite{leroy2009,lopes2015}.

positions.paragraph: Recent code-watermark systems instantiate this design space in different ways. SrcMarker applies scalable source transformations and reports message recovery alongside supplied-test outcomes~\cite{yang2023}. SEW constrains style transformations with structural, type, and effect checks~\cite{sew2026}; CREST releases a Python rewrite catalogue and probabilistic detector heads~\cite{crest2026}; and ACW emphasizes universal detection together with post-attack utility~\cite{acw2026}. Generation-time methods such as SWEET, CodeIP, and STONE trade detectability against code-quality or execution proxies at selected operating points~\cite{lee2024,guan2024,kim2025}. MarkLLM, Mark My Words, and WaterPark broaden watermark evaluation across robustness and quality dimensions~\cite{pan2024markllm,piet2024markmywords,liang2025waterpark}.

references.title: Regression Testing Minimization, Selection and Prioritization: A Survey

positions.paragraph:
\subsection{Reuse and early stopping require a comparison-specific invariant}
Regression-test selection avoids repeated execution by identifying tests affected by a program change. Safe techniques preserve a specified fault-detection capability under explicit assumptions, while empirical studies characterize granularity, precision, and cost~\cite{rothermel1997,rothermel1998,engstrom2010,yoo2012}. Test-case prioritization changes the execution order so that relevant failures appear earlier~\cite{rothermel2001}. Test selection for learned systems likewise chooses cases using downstream objectives and available metadata~\cite{ma2021selection}. These lines motivate avoiding redundant suites, but ordinary change-based reuse does not answer our identity question: the same candidate can have different behavioral labels under different references or harnesses, and different version rows can assert the same proposition even when their production paths differ.
